competitive landscape section heading

source_content: There are strong adjacent products. Simplify currently reports 2M+ users and 200M+ applications, and it offers editable resume builders and layouts. Teal reports 4M+ members. Jobscan reports 10M+ job seekers and 20M+ resumes scanned. NTUC's AI Career Coach reported more than 3,500 users by the end of October 2025 and already combines jobs, skills matching, resume building and interview simulation. Jobbatical focuses on global mobility for employers, with 17,000+ relocations across 45+ countries. These are not identical products, but they show that the market is real and that individual features are already valuable.
notes: competitor stats narrative

source_content: Our opportunity Do not compete on “more templates,” “more job listings,” or “more applications.” Compete on the quality of the candidate feedback loop: the ability to diagnose, improve, evidence, apply, measure and mentor.
